#!/bin/bash
set -e

LOG_DIR="/logs"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

run_migration() {
    echo "=============================="

}

run_test() {
    echo "=============================="
    echo "  单元测试"
    echo "=============================="
    pytest tests/ -v --tb=short --junitxml="${LOG_DIR}/test_report_${TIMESTAMP}.xml" 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_DIR}/test_${TIMESTAMP}.log"
    echo "测试完成: ${LOG_DIR}/test_${TIMESTAMP}.log"
}

run_all() {
    run_migration
    echo ""
    run_test
}

case "${1:-all}" in
    migrate)  run_migration ;;
    test)     run_test ;;
    all)      run_all ;;
    *)        echo "用法: docker compose run --rm runner [migrate|test|all]" ;;
esac
EOF
